sloka: पृष्ठतोऽहम् गमिष्यामि सायुधो द्विपदाम् वर ।यद्यत्फलम् प्रार्थयते पुष्पम् वा जनकात्मजा ॥२-५५-२८॥
transliteration: pṛṣṭhato'ham gamiṣyāmi sāyudho dvipadām vara ।yadyatphalam prārthayate puṣpam vā janakātmajā ॥2-55-28॥

translations.english: Whatever fruit or flower the daughter of Janaka asks for, get it. Whatever pleases her mind give it.
